## Historical audit — H0094

**Scope.** Only chunk 2 of 2 is visible. Original file for all event citations: `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/hint-codex-experiments/runs/codex_parallel_08/lanes/codex_parallel_08_lane2/codex_parallel_08_lane2_I_r1/infer_logs/ink-grid-box-layout/turn_1/trajs.json`. Bracketed ranges are observation character offsets.

| Aspect | Evidence and interpretation |
|---|---|
| Goal | The inferred goal was grid layout for Ink boxes alongside Yoga flex layout, including track sizing and placement. The original task request is not visible; the supplied system reference describes this direction (main_agent:event:58 [0,11472)). |
| Teacher input and adoption | The process listing captures an appended system reminder containing a problem diagnosis, suggested investigations, test dimensions, and file clues. It required independent verification and prohibited locating the reference or evaluation internals (event:58 [0,11472)). This is evidence the text was supplied in the student process command, not merely archived availability. The separate grid module, rendering integration, and tests overlap its suggestions, but the visible record does not establish which choices were caused by it; no online teacher delivery is visible here. |
| Changes | The observed implementation parses tracks and placements, sizes and positions children, restores modified Yoga styles, and repeats layout for grids (events:50 [0,9548), 62 [0,11285)). Later edits grow bounded tracks before fractional allocation, skip repeated arrangement when no grid exists, and allow row-specified placement beyond existing columns (events:50, 61–62, 67–68). The diff adds grid style properties and connects live and string rendering to the new layout function (event:72 [0,6908)). Four files were committed, including the new module (event:76 [0,1200)). |
| Exploration and validation | The student ran manual string-render probes for tracks, gaps, rows, borders and padding; outputs are visible, but no independent expected-value assertions accompany them (events:53–54, 59–60). An initial AVA run timed out; a later build and focused regression run passed 42 tests, with environment warnings (events:54 [0,573), 70 [0,5586)). Lint initially reported an error and two warnings; after an edit, the final formatting command reported two warnings and no error (events:66–68, 74). |
| Outcome | **Partial correctness, formally not solved:** supplied inventory metadata reports 24/25 fail-to-pass and 49/49 pass-to-pass checks. It does not identify the failed case. The nonempty committed patch and passing local tests do not establish full correctness; the earlier test timeout was a technical interruption, not by itself an algorithm diagnosis. |

**Lessons and uncertainty.** Transferably, probe behavior separately from build and regression checks, and distinguish a timed-out run from a failing assertion. Task-specific concerns include intrinsic sizing, partially explicit placement, nested grids, and restoring geometry on rerender. Whether any of these caused the one formal failure remains an unresolved hypothesis. The final formatter modified the grid file after the successful build/test run (event:74 [0,1202)); no subsequent build is visible. Scene-specific object, material, pose, camera and lighting checks do not apply to this code task.
